stories.title: Mendonça dá 24h para remoção de posts sobre Lula e bandeira do Brasil

en.title: Mendonça gives 24 hours for removal of posts about Lula and Brazilian flag
en.summary: TSE minister André Mendonça ordered social media platforms to remove false posts claiming President Lula threw the Brazilian flag on the ground after voting, with posts from influencer Pablo Marçal and others targeted.

stories.title: Governo Lula pede ao STF para manter proibição das bets no Brasil e cita R$ 7 bi lavados em sites clandestinos

en.title: Lula government asks STF to maintain ban on betting in Brazil and cites R$ 7 billion laundered on illegal sites
en.summary: Brazil's Attorney General's office requested that the Supreme Court uphold the provisional measure prohibiting online sports betting and casinos, citing concerns about money laundering through illegal betting platforms.

stories.title: AGU defende proibição das bets e pede nova audiência sobre o tema no STF

en.title: AGU defends ban on bets and requests new hearing on the subject at STF
en.summary: Brazil's Attorney General's Office defended a prohibition on betting companies before the Supreme Court and requested a new hearing on the matter. The government's interim measure that shut down betting operations is being challenged by industry entities.

stories.title: Alexandre de Moraes encaminha à PGR pedido de Bolsonaro para receber visita de Flávio

en.title: Alexandre de Moraes forwards Bolsonaro's request to receive visit from Flávio to the PGR
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes sent to the General Prosecutor's Office a request from Bolsonaro's defense seeking permission for the former president to receive visits from his son Flávio. The matter awaits the prosecutor's office opinion.

stories.title: Bancos revisam projeção de inadimplência para o fim do ano de 5,8% para 6,1%

en.title: Banks revise default projection for year-end from 5.8% to 6.1%
en.summary: Brazilian banks raised their delinquency forecast for free-resource credit by year-end from 5.8% to 6.1%, reflecting worsening sector expectations. Credit growth projections remained stable at 8.9% this year but decreased for 2027.

stories.title: Polícia britânica faz nova prisão por suspeita de plano terrorista contra base aérea

en.title: British police make new arrest on suspicion of terrorist plot against air base
en.summary: British police arrested a 22-year-old man in London on suspicion of planning terrorist acts related to an alleged plot near RAF Fairford, a U.S. air base used for operations against Iran. The arrest is part of an ongoing investigation into the suspected threat.

stories.title: Pedro Ramalho transforma o The Eye Motel em fenômeno de marketing e experiência

en.title: Pedro Ramalho transforms The Eye Motel into a marketing and experience phenomenon
en.summary: A 26-year-old entrepreneur and influencer from Londrina showcased his renovated motel at Equipotel, Latin America's largest motel industry fair in São Paulo. Ramalho has turned the motel business into an entertainment and business topic, building a following exceeding 300,000 on social media after reviving an abandoned establishment.
